title: Allocation/Affirmation Conformance Checker
description: Classifies allocation, confirmation, receipt-confirmation and settlement-instruction events against the adopted Commission Delegated Regulation C(2026) 4640 final, which applies from 2026-12-07, and against the UK T+1 Code of Conduct as a second declared regime. Deadlines are derived from caller-declared inputs only. Reports evaluated, excluded and unresolved counts, per-event classifications with stable reason codes, and no rate at all when nothing could be evaluated.

output_example.rate_basis: on-time and conforming events divided by evaluated events. Malformed, not-evaluable and duplicate events are excluded from both sides and reported separately. No rate is produced when nothing could be evaluated.
output_example.cutoff_disclosure: Deadlines are evaluated against 23:00 read as a fixed UTC+1 offset all year. The regulation states "23:00 CET" and does not define CET against CEST; see T1-AUTHORITY-CROSSWALK-2026-09-24 section 4.
disclosures: Deadlines are evaluated against 23:00 read as a fixed UTC+1 offset all year. The regulation states "23:00 CET" and does not define CET against CEST; see T1-AUTHORITY-CROSSWALK-2026-09-24 section 4.
Business days are Monday to Friday. No public-holiday calendar is applied, so a next-business-day deadline that falls on a public holiday is not adjusted.
No rule_version was declared, so the result cannot be tied to a pinned version of the rule text.
No source_digests were declared, so the rule text behind this result is not bound to a pinned digest.
output_example.note: DECISION-SUPPORT DRAFT, not a regulatory finding and not a certification. Deadlines come from caller-declared inputs; this kernel reads no clock and resolves no timezone database. It does not verify that the underlying records are complete or true.
